name: pickup_set_next_pickup_id
description: Pickup::SetNextPickupId replaces the global next pickup id and returns its previous value.
known_limits: The shared pickup leaf-helper smoke also covers adjacent pickup leaf functions. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Pickup runtime pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e960 validates reading g_NextPickupId, writing the input value back to g_NextPickupId, and returning the old value.
The native pickup leaf-helper smoke verifies GetNextPickupId sees the original value, SetNextPickupId returns it while installing the replacement, and a later read observes the new value.
